subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘BRIGHT’ is written as ‘TTKIJB’ and ‘ROAST’ is written as ‘TQCUR’. How will ‘AROUND’ be written in that language?
solution:
According to the English alphabets & their positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] 

The pattern followed in the given codes is:

**First & last alphabets are interchanged, rest of the alphabets are increased by +2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2e94f28f0cbb2c76268b72a2ffefedc38c42c4d37e761d643c2298ae54d104b.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53834aed279a26b92bb31ae39ee1c79303519d56d6e64ee8585ece86791e14b8.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7f334ef6fb4b015cfc71e0a2e3e37ca1c86fd887a7d6a45c4af8ea0a74e1932.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
